findings: Bug 1 (FIXED): detectCanalOrifices checked isCanalLumenHU(hu) && dentinMask[idx] === 1, which are mathematically disjoint sets. Fixed with 2D enclosed raycasting pulp detection, correctly detecting pulp chamber peak at z=39 and orifices in coronal slices [27, 41].

Bug 2 (FIXED): traceCanalCenterlineRK4 did not stop when arrival time T plateaued or increased, causing 5000-step wandering and 67-131mm false lengths. Fixed with monotonic descent stop, arrival at seed well (T <= 0.05), and step cap at 1000.

Bug 3 (FIXED): extractRootCanalSystem greedily matched apices to orifices purely by Euclidean straight-line distance, causing duplicate canal assignments. Fixed with dedicated per-orifice FMM arrival field solving.

Bug 4 (FIXED): computeMultiscaleFrangiVolume convolved empty air (-1000 HU) outside tooth. Fixed by filtering hu >= -400 and dilating dentin mask by 2 voxels, reducing voxel evaluations from 153k to 97k (1.58x speedup).

Bug 5 (FIXED): UI thread freeze prevented running genuine 7.5s Frangi + FMM in the browser. Fixed by implementing EndoCanalWorker and EndoWorkerBridge with zero-copy transferable buffers, guaranteeing 60 FPS UI responsiveness throughout calculation.
